extracted.name: Microwave Corn on the Cob
extracted.description: You can microwave corn on the cob easily and save on stove or grill space. Fresh summer sweet corn, ready in minutes with this no-nonsense recipe.
instruction_lines: Remove husk and silk from ear of corn.
Wet a paper towel, then wring it out so it's still moist. Wrap the moist towel around the ear of corn and place it on a microwave-safe plate.
Cook in the microwave until kernels are tender but still crisp when poked with a knife, 2 to 5 minutes.
Carefully remove and discard paper towel before serving.
